purpose: Persist the deduplicated Triggerword-5 effect/enforcement/completion findings as an append-only contract for Triggerword-4 Frankenstein-2.0 assembly without modifying the Frankenstein donor or minting runtime credit.

cross_checked_current_source_facts.fact: The donor section named EffectGate intentionally does not block ordinary Claude Code tool execution; it records admission/idempotency/outcome bookkeeping.

The current completion verifier accepts an effect proof when the same-session effect exists and is not the legacy lowercase status 'fehler'; this predicate is not successor-safe for current Phase-2 statuses such as ABGELEHNT, UNGEPRUEFT, WIEDERHOLUNG and FEHLGESCHLAGEN.

A textual test:<exit_code>:<description> proof is accepted solely on exit_code string 0 and is not bound to an observed runner, command, source SHA, environment, output digest or immutable execution receipt.

PreToolUse and PostToolUse have a call-scoped tool_use_id, while the donor correlates effect lifecycle through a mutable session-scoped active_turns.effect_id slot. Parallel tool-call semantics make the weaker identity unsuitable as the Frankenstein-2.0 contract even though an exact runtime race was not reproduced in this Triggerword-5 pass.

The donor stern source names an older blocking global guard at ~/aicore/opt/aicore/tools/schranke/wache-koenig.py, but that guard is not present in the exact pinned Frankenstein donor tree inspected here; its actual source/config/order/behavior therefore cannot receive donor-artifact enforcement credit.

The packaged plugin hooks route all seven plugin hook events through command invocations of scripts/stern.py and explicitly describe this plugin path as fail-silent/exit-0. The separate host-global hook composition is not reconstructed by the donor artifact.

Historical stern chronology records failures from process-lifetime config caching, dropped outcome_json forwarding and UnifiedDB schema drift. These are lineage evidence for typed generation/result-reentry contracts, not newly reproduced runtime evidence in this pass.

triggerword4_mandatory_effect_contract.invocation_identity: Bind PreToolUse -> enforcement -> execution -> PostToolUse/PostToolUseFailure -> journal -> result re-entry to immutable tool_use_id or an equally exact generated invocation_id. session_id is contextual identity only and must never be the sole mutable effect pointer.
triggerword4_mandatory_effect_contract.enforcement: A policy intended to prevent a real effect receives enforcement credit only when the exact host blocking adapter/source/config/order is artifact-bound and an allow/deny receipt is bound to the invocation identity. Bookkeeping status is not enforcement.
triggerword4_mandatory_effect_contract.completion: Work completion must use an explicit allowlist of admissible, generation/provenance-bound receipt states. DENIED, FAILED, UNCHECKED, UNKNOWN, stale, duplicate-unresolved and unbound textual test claims cannot close work.
triggerword4_mandatory_effect_contract.world_effect: A successful command/tool return is not automatically proof of arbitrary external-world side effects. Unknown external outcome remains UNKNOWN until an observation/receipt appropriate to that effect is bound and re-entered.
triggerword4_mandatory_effect_contract.generation: Config/schema/source generation and migration compatibility must be explicit across long-lived consumers and durable writers/readers; process topology changes are treated as semantic changes requiring freshness tests.
triggerword4_mandatory_effect_contract.parallel_calls: Parallel/batched calls require independent per-invocation lifecycle state; no shared mutable single current-effect slot.
triggerword4_mandatory_effect_contract.fail_closed: Missing enforcement artifact identity, ambiguous hook order, stale generation, unbound completion evidence or unknown world outcome fails closed at the authority boundary.

contradictions_preserved: Current EntityOS design requires deterministic real-effect authority, while the donor's named EffectGate explicitly says ordinary tools proceed regardless of its admission status.
The completion verifier comment predicts automatic stricter behavior after Phase-2 status migration, while its executable predicate remains a legacy != 'fehler' check.
The donor references a real blocking global guard but does not contain the guard artifact needed to reproduce or audit that enforcement path.
not_promoted: No source-only finding is promoted to measured causal runtime behavior.
No host-global hook order is inferred from plugin-local hooks.json.
No repository absence claim is upgraded to proof that wache-koenig never existed on the host.
No parallel-call race is claimed as reproduced without a real scheduler trace.
No component/source evidence grants Frankenstein-2.0, GRID10, HCU, EntityOS, J-Space or training PASS.
next_exact_gate: Acquire and hash the actual wache-koenig/global-hook artifact or permanently preserve the source hole; verify real hook composition/order and per-tool tool_use_id lifecycle under the exact host scheduler; resolve exact first/last Git windows for effect/completion, config/outcome and schema-generation edges; then merge only verified windows into FAILURE_ATLAS/EMERGENT_COUPLING_GRAPH and implement the typed contract in the separate Triggerword-4 assembly lane.
